description: This file exports constants and a module object related to diagram rendering, specifically for sequence diagrams or similar UML-like diagrams. It contains configuration data, parsing rules, and functions for managing diagram components such as actors, messages, boxes, and loops, as well as external library references for DOM manipulation (likely D3.js).

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A parser class generated for diagram syntax, contains parsing rules, lexer, and parse functions.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Handles various production rules during parsing to construct diagram components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Entry point for parsing a diagram definition string into diagram model components.
